# Vibe Board v3.1.1

Vibe Board is a local-first desktop console for monitoring AI coding-agent sessions and managing shared Skills.

## Highlights

- Antigravity desktop and `agy` CLI detection with lifecycle and permission hooks.
- Shared Skill inventory, adoption, distribution, diagnosis, and GitHub update sync.
- Windows tray behavior, background probes, and installer improvements.
- Real token totals when available; otherwise the last known provider quota and reset time.

## Notes

- macOS and Windows builds are supported; Windows installers are currently unsigned.
- Release files are attached to the GitHub Release that triggered this workflow.
- Auto-update endpoints and signing keys must be configured for the destination repository before enabling signed updates.
